subject: Culture
title: Food Sovereignty
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Food Sovereignty.

hook.text: La Vía Campesina represents 200 million farmers who demand the right to grow their own food their own way.

buildup.text: Food sovereignty opposes corporate control of seeds, land, and farming methods.

discovery.text: Monsanto once sued farmers for saving seeds. Corporate patents turned ancient practices into crimes.

twist.text: Indigenous communities in the Andes still grow 4,000 potato varieties. Monoculture threatens that diversity.

climax.text: Who controls the food controls the future. Sovereignty starts at the seed.

quiz.question: What does the food sovereignty movement primarily oppose?
